# PC Anatomy

> PC Anatomy is a free, open-source 3D computer anatomy learning resource. Explore an interactive 3D computer model, learn what PC components do, and see how to assemble a desktop PC.

## Start here

- [Interactive 3D computer explorer](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/explore): Explore computer parts and inspect components in an interactive model.
- [Desktop PC assembly guide](https://pc-anatomy.brickshow.site/assembly): General step-by-step instructions for assembling a desktop PC.

## Site information
